laws.rule: Smoking or dropping cigarette butts is prohibited (except in designated areas) on Phra Ae, Khlong Dao and Khok Kwang beaches on Ko Lanta. The penalty is up to one year's jail and/or a fine of up to THB 100,000. DMCR Order 864/2563 (2020) covered these for two years; a later renewal has not been confirmed here.
laws.heading: Department of Marine and Coastal Resources, beach smoking order
